raw_segments.text: I hope you will not think it is impolite that I should write this note to you when you wish
Please believe I do not mean to be impolite or try to find out anything at all.
Only I want to thank you for being so kind to me, so heavenly kind and making everything
I am so grateful to you, and I am so happy and so is Becky.
Becky feels just as thankful as I do it is all just as beautiful and wonderful to her
We used to be so lonely and cold and hungry, and now oh, just think what you have done
Please let me say just these words.
It seems as if I ought to say them.
Thank you, thank you, thank you.
